surface.coordinates: t: root-to-tip [0,1]; u: chord [-1,1]; blade0 world +X = screen-left from +Y

contact_gate: frames[i].contact_duty.simultaneous; fraction of preceding 50 one-millisecond substeps; only stage scripted scrub contributes mask
timestamp_convention: mj_step contact/geom positions at start of 1 ms integration; timestamp is integration end
retargeting: These world poses are validated only on the unchanged fixed bench. Retargeting to BlueROV mounts is kinematic presentation, not validated wet dynamics.
cleaning: Coverage is a contact-gated nominal pad footprint estimate. Render only cumulative footprint; no whole-blade clean or material-removal claim.

clearance.clearance_evaluation: every 1 ms; enclosing 26 mm disk vs exact polygon rim; mj_geomDistance tool+right fingers vs all collidable left geoms

coverage.geometric_touch_definition: Area quadrature on collision-matched front triangles whose centroids enter actual pad ellipsoid at a simultaneous-contact 1ms substep. Contact-overlap estimate, not abrasion. Submillimetre contact patch discretization may miss smaller touches.
coverage.interpretation: Contact-gated swept nominal 52 mm disk on actual blade triangles; upper footprint estimate, not force-bearing contact area or removed fouling. No abrasion model.

coverage_mask: coverage_mask.npz: surface_xyz_m, surface_tu, area_m2, first_touch_time_s (geometric overlap), nominal_first_touch_time_s (nominal whole-disk sweep)
